```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

schools = read_csv("ont-school-demo-info.csv")
```

```{r}
special_schools <- schools |>
  filter(school_special_condition_code %in% c("Deaf", "Blind", "Deaf/Blind"))

special_schools |>
  filter(year == "2024-2025") |>
  select(
    school_number, school_name, condition = school_special_condition_code,
    city, school_level, grade_range, school_language, enrolment
  ) |>
  arrange(condition, city, school_level) |>
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r count-schools-by-special-education-percentage}
school_counts <- schools |>
  filter(year == "2024-2025") |>
  mutate(
    percentage_group = cut(
      percentage_of_students_receiving_special_education_services,
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
      labels = c(
        "0–10%",
        paste0(">", seq(10, 90, by = 10), "–", seq(20, 100, by = 10), "%")
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(percentage_group)) |>
  count(percentage_group, name = "number_of_schools", .drop = FALSE)

school_counts
```
